units.text: Synthetic Local Cache. Author: Demo Team. This is a synthetic example, not a real paper.
We address repeated queries over the same documents. Store the last query results keyed by document ID; reuse only if the document version is unchanged.

On ToySet test, the same model, requests, CPU and memory limit are used. Baseline median latency is 20 ms; ours is 12 ms. Accuracy is unchanged. No repeated-run or significance results are supplied here.
Independent queries are not evaluated. We plan to release code after publication; no repository link is supplied.
